cap_OpTwin.text:
Capabilities: shared-shell, shared-top-bar, shared-navigation, shared-table, shared-primary-button, shared-search, app-switcher.
What you see: Nextcloud Files and the OpenProject work package table side by side under one top bar, with six numbered identical regions and their sizes. Below it the shared bar with the app switcher open, Nextcloud apps and OpenProject side by side.

cap_OpHowItWorks.text:
Capabilities: one-token-set, thematiq-adapter, openproject-plugin-proposal, design-system-admin, pixel-diff-check.
What you see: Five steps: an admin picks a design system once, one Cunningham token set, two adapters (thematiq exists, the OpenProject plugin is a proposal), two products with a pixel-diff check between them. A strip at the bottom says what is identical to the pixel and what is built from the same primitives.

cap_OpPrimitives.text:
Capabilities: button, input, select, checkbox-and-switch, tabs, badge-and-chip, status-and-type, table, dialog.
What you see: Nine rows, each with the canon size on the left and the Nextcloud and OpenProject version side by side, visibly identical. The sizes are the canon, not a measured result.

cap_OpHome.text:
Capabilities: my-work-packages, my-projects, project-news, this-week, shared-shell.
What you see: Olivia's home in the shared shell: her five work packages, her three projects with next milestone and progress, project news and a strip for this week.

cap_OpProjectOverview.text:
Capabilities: project-status, description, work-packages-by-status, members, milestones, activity.
What you see: The project page with an on track badge, three cards (description, work packages by status, members) and below them the milestones next to the latest activity.

cap_OpWorkPackages.text:
Capabilities: work-package-table, filters, grouping, type-and-status-rendering, create-work-package, column-sort.
What you see: The Northwind rollout Lyon table grouped by status, with filter chips, a filter button, group by, a view toggle, search in the list and the green create action.

cap_OpWorkPackage.text:
Capabilities: work-package-full-view, status-change, attributes, tabs, linked-nextcloud-files, activity.
What you see: FEATURE #58412 with a status button and the tabs Overview, Activity, Files and Relations. Files is open: the Nextcloud project folder and four linked files, with attributes and activity in a 360 px aside.

cap_OpCreateWorkPackage.text:
Capabilities: create-dialog, type, parent, assignee, priority, dates, link-nextcloud-folder.
What you see: The work package table dimmed under the create dialog, filled in for a child of #58390 and assigned to Tom. This is the dialog primitive from the canon.

cap_OpBoards.text:
Capabilities: status-columns, work-package-cards, column-counts, board-type-switcher, add-card.
What you see: Five status columns with the nine open work packages as cards. Overdue dates are red.

cap_OpGantt.text:
Capabilities: table-and-timeline, day-scale, today-line, epic-bar, milestone, follows-dependency, zoom, pdf-export.
What you see: Ten rows from 5 October to 8 November: the epic as an outlined bar over its children, one dependency arrow, a diamond for the go-live milestone and a dashed line for today.

cap_OpCalendar.text:
Capabilities: month-grid, work-package-spans, due-chips, meetings, layer-toggles, today-marker.
What you see: October 2026 with work packages as bars and due chips in their type colour, and the Thursday review meetings as filled blocks.

cap_OpTeamPlanner.text:
Capabilities: row-per-assignee, two-week-scale, work-package-bars, planned-hours, over-capacity-warning, not-scheduled-list.
What you see: Olivia, Tom and Priya with their work packages as bars over two weeks. Tom is over capacity, and a side card lists two work packages that still need dates.

cap_OpBacklogs.text:
Capabilities: sprint-backlog, product-backlog, story-points, drag-order, new-sprint, burndown.
What you see: Sprint 21 on the left, the product backlog on the right, each with story points per row, and a burndown card below.

cap_OpMeetings.text:
Capabilities: agenda-items, work-package-per-item, outcomes, participants, add-to-calendar, close-agenda.
What you see: The rollout review of Thursday 15 October with five agenda items linked to work packages, three outcomes and the participants with their reply.

cap_OpWiki.text:
Capabilities: page-tree, page-history, headings, embedded-work-package, table, edit-page.
What you see: The phase 2 rollout plan beside the page tree, with #58412 embedded as a linked card and a table of sites and dates.

cap_OpTimeCosts.text:
Capabilities: logged-hours, budget-against-spent, period-chips, group-by, log-time, export.
What you see: Three tiles for hours and costs, a budget bar and the October entries grouped by work package, with person, activity and hours.

cap_OpMembers.text:
Capabilities: member-list, roles, organisation-filter, invite-member, add-group, resend-invitation.
What you see: Six members with role badges and status, the invite action, and a card that explains what each role allows.

cap_OpNotifications.text:
Capabilities: one-list-for-both-products, filter-per-product, group-by-day, mark-as-read, row-actions.
What you see: Two day groups with seven notifications from OpenProject and Nextcloud in one list: mentions on work packages, a shared file, a status change and a meeting invite.

cap_OpProjectSettings.text:
Capabilities: name-and-description, status, modules-on-and-off, nextcloud-project-folder, save.
What you see: A general form on the left, module switches and the linked Nextcloud project folder on the right.

cap_OpAdmin.text:
Capabilities: administration-menu, users-and-groups, types-and-statuses, authentication, file-storages, design, plugins.
What you see: The administration menu in the shared sidebar style, six overview cards and a short log of recent changes.

cap_OpThemePicker.text:
Capabilities: design-system-list, active-badge, applies-to-nextcloud, import-token-set, preview, apply-to-both-products.
What you see: Four design systems as cards, Cunningham selected and Northwind house style active, with a notice that the same choice applies to Nextcloud.

cap_OpThemeEditor.text:
Capabilities: edit-colours, type-family, radius, logo, live-preview, save-to-both-products.
What you see: The token form on the left and a live preview of the shared shell on the right, with a switch between OpenProject and Nextcloud.

cap_OpSignIn.text:
Capabilities: single-sign-on, password, passkey, keep-signed-in, destination-line.
What you see: One sign-in card for both products, with a line that says where you are going and which apps the same session opens.

cap_OpHeader.text:
Capabilities: shared-top-bar, app-switcher, global-search, notifications, help, account-menu.
What you see: The one 68 px top bar both products share: logo and app name, app switcher, search, notifications, help and account.

cap_OpNav.text:
Capabilities: project-menu, project-switcher, create-work-package.
What you see: The OpenProject project menu drawn as our 264 px sidebar: the green create action, the project switcher, two groups, and members and project settings at the bottom.

cap_OpWorkPackageOpen.text:
Capabilities: work-package-full-view, status-change, watch, edit, tabs-with-counts, description-with-checklist, grouped-attributes, progress, latest-activity, comment.
What you see: FEATURE #58412 with the Overview tab open: the description as real text with a scope checklist, the latest activity and a comment box, next to a 360 px aside with people, estimates and progress, details and project.

cap_OpWorkPackageSplit.text:
Capabilities: split-view, narrowed-table, opened-row-highlight, side-panel, open-in-full-view, close-panel, tabs-with-counts, grouped-attributes, comment.
What you see: Navigation, the work package table and a 440 px panel side by side. The opened row is highlighted in the table, and the panel shows the same work package with the Overview tab open and a button to open it in full view.
